sources.title_original: Structured forms for private vulnerability reports
sources.summary:
Private vulnerability reports can now use a structured form that asks reporters for the details you need to assess a vulnerability, including a reproducible proof of concept. A single free-text…
Private vulnerability reports can now use a structured form that asks reporters for the details you need to assess a vulnerability, including a reproducible proof of concept.
A single free-text box made it easy to submit low-quality or AI-generated reports and hard for you to find the signal in them. Now
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 值得开发者一读：GitHub 私有漏洞报告新增结构化表单，默认强制填写 summary、details、proof of concept（至少 150 字符）和 impact，并说明公开仓库在 GitHub Free、Pro、Team、Enterprise Cloud 启用后可用，以及 REST API 与自定义表单不符时报错并指向新端点。

sources.summary: Black Forest Labs 的 FLUX 3 Image 现已上线 OpenRouter，是支持文生图与多参考编辑的旗舰图像模型，原生可渲染至 4K。原文提到可精确多轮编辑不动其他像素、用 bounding box 布局、最多用 10 个参考图合成，商业权重已开放，开放权重版将在未来数周发布。

items.title: OpenAI 称拦截蒸馏窃取攻击，但研究者称同样手法在 Azure 上仍可窃取 GPT-6 Astra 等模型的推理内容 / OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure

sources.title: OpenAI 称拦截蒸馏窃取攻击，但研究者称同样手法在 Azure 上仍可窃取 GPT-6 Astra 等模型的推理内容 / OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure

sources.title_original: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
sources.summary: OpenAI 称 7 月拦截了一起针对其模型推理链的蒸馏窃取活动，7 月 24 至 25 日出现来自超 4000 用户的 16000 次请求，关联账号超 15000 个，OpenAI 将其与 Moonshot AI 相关人员联系起来，并于 7 月 28 日关停。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI称已关闭超15,000个账号试图复制其模型隐藏推理的对抗性蒸馏行动，部分关联Moonshot AI，但研究人员发现同一手法在Microsoft Azure上持续数周，甚至对新GPT-6 Astra仍有效。

items.summary: OpenAI 称 7 月拦截了一起针对其模型推理链的蒸馏窃取活动，7 月 24 至 25 日出现来自超 4000 用户的 16000 次请求，关联账号超 15000 个，OpenAI 将其与 Moonshot AI 相关人员联系起来，并于 7 月 28 日关停。
items.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI称已关闭超15,000个账号试图复制其模型隐藏推理的对抗性蒸馏行动，部分关联Moonshot AI，但研究人员发现同一手法在Microsoft Azure上持续数周，甚至对新GPT-6 Astra仍有效。
